# Directional daily option selling (auto-generated by `run_directional.py`)

Data 2021-04-01 -> 2026-11-22 (2059 days, 5.6 yrs). Sell 1 ATM daily option at 08:00 UTC, strike = spot, take the whole loss. IV = DVOL x 0.95, Deribit fee 0.03% (cap 12.5% of premium). USD per 1 ETH option.

|                                                 |   PnL $ |   PnL $/yr |   options sold |   PnL $/option |   edge bps/option |   win % |   max DD $ |   worst day $ |   Sharpe |   premium $ |   fees $ |

| always sell put                                 |   7,055 |      1,250 |          2,059 |           3.43 |              15.9 |    71.0 |     -1,751 |          -580 |     1.05 |      76,633 |    1,561 |

## 2. Where the rule's PnL comes from: sell call vs sell put, split by previous candle

|                   |   sell call $ |   sell put $ |   days |
|:------------------|--------------:|-------------:|-------:|
| after UP candle   |         5,010 |        5,850 |  1,048 |
| after DOWN candle |         2,108 |        1,172 |  1,010 |


|                         |   trades |   PnL $ |
|:------------------------|---------:|--------:|
| calls after DOWN candle |    1,010 |   2,108 |
| puts after UP candle    |    1,048 |   5,850 |


## 3. Permutation test
Real signals: +7,958 USD. Random shuffles of the same up/down signals: mean +7,034, 5-95% range +3,333 .. +10,703. **p-value = 0.335** (share of shuffles that did at least as well).

## 3b. Timing: selling (either side) after UP vs after DOWN candles

|                   |   days |   edge bps/option |   next-day |move| bps |   DVOL % |
|:------------------|-------:|------------------:|----------------------:|---------:|
| after UP candle   |  1,048 |              19.2 |                   245 |     72.9 |
| after DOWN candle |  1,010 |               5.6 |                   274 |     73.5 |


Difference t-stat 2.46, permutation p = 0.010. By year (edge bps/option):

|   2025 |        7.9 |        -10.5 |
|   2026 |       19.3 |         -0.2 |
